name: Modern Metal Company
old_description: Custom metal fabrication solutions for residential and commercial projects since 2020.
about:
Modern Metal Company operates from Lowell, Arkansas, where it was founded in 2020 by Victor Onishenko. The business began as a custom metal fabrication shop serving residential and commercial projects across Northwest Arkansas and Southwest Missouri.

The company fabricates custom metal railings, including staircase, spiral staircase, and floating staircase systems, along with its proprietary Levaplate® leveling system that uses set screws to eliminate washers and shims. In-house capabilities cover welding in stainless steel, aluminum, and steel, premium powder coating on all products, and full installation services. To date, the shop has installed more than 150 custom railings.

Customers include builders and homeowners constructing or remodeling higher-end homes in Northwest Arkansas and the Joplin, Missouri area, as well as elderly clients needing handrails. The company also takes on commercial projects requiring architectural metalwork.

Modern Metal Company emphasizes a 6-to-8-week lead time, well below the industry norm of 8 to 12 months, and provides direct communication with the owner, free shop drawings, and a turnkey service from quote through installation and cleanup. The Levaplate® system and hidden-hardware design are cited as key differentiators.
